senses.en: polite and respectful behavior between people or groups

example.en: The two nations maintained comity despite their disagreements.
example.zh: 两国尽管有分歧，仍保持相互礼让。

senses.en: a flat shape with four sides

example.en: A square is the most regular quadrangle.
example.zh: 正方形是最规则的四边形。

senses.en: an open area surrounded by buildings, especially in a school or college
senses.zh: 四方庭院，（学校等的）四方院子

example.en: Students gathered in the college quadrangle.
example.zh: 学生们聚集在学院的四方院子里。

senses.en: unable to be bribed or morally corrupted

example.en: The judge was known for being incorruptible.
example.zh: 这位法官以清廉著称。

senses.en: a person who lives in a town

example.en: Most townsmen worked in shops rather than on farms.
example.zh: 大多数镇民在店铺工作，而非务农。

senses.en: a person from the same town as someone else

example.en: He greeted me as a fellow townsman.
example.zh: 他作为同乡向我打招呼。

senses.en: to give a document an earlier date than the real one

example.en: The contract was backdated to the first of January.
example.zh: 这份合同的日期被倒填到1月1日。

senses.en: consisting of two legislative chambers

example.en: Congress is a bicameral legislature.
example.zh: 美国国会是一个两院制立法机构。

senses.en: used to get someone's attention or to greet someone

example.en: Hey, wait for me!
example.zh: 嘿，等等我！

senses.en: the state of having lost all hope

example.en: In desperation, he called everyone he knew for help.
example.zh: 绝望之中，他给认识的每个人都打了电话求助。

senses.en: reckless behavior driven by despair

example.en: Her desperation drove her to take risks.
example.zh: 绝望驱使她去冒险。

senses.en: money paid to allow an accused person to stay out of custody until trial

example.en: The judge set bail at fifty thousand dollars.
example.zh: 法官将保释金定为五万美元。

senses.en: to release someone after security has been paid

example.en: His family paid the fee to bail him out.
example.zh: 他的家人交了钱把他保释出来。

senses.en: to remove water from a boat

example.en: They used buckets to bail water out of the boat.
example.zh: 他们用水桶把水从船里舀出去。

senses.en: one of the two openings of the nose

example.en: Cold air rushed in through his nostrils.
example.zh: 冷空气从他的鼻孔涌入。

senses.en: a person who believes in and follows the teachings of Buddhism

example.en: Many Buddhists visit the temple to meditate.
example.zh: 许多佛教徒去寺庙冥想。

senses.en: relating to Buddhism or its teachings

example.en: The monastery is an important Buddhist site.
example.zh: 这座寺院是一处重要的佛教圣地。

senses.en: a lack of patience; irritation with delays

example.en: She waited for the results with growing impatience.
example.zh: 她越来越不耐烦地等待结果。

senses.en: completely correct and precise in every detail

example.en: The exact time of the meeting has not been announced.
example.zh: 会议的确切时间尚未公布。

senses.en: to demand and obtain something, often by force or authority
senses.zh: 强求；索取（常指以权力或强制手段）

example.en: The government exacted a heavy tax on imported goods.
example.zh: 政府对进口商品征收了重税。

senses.en: worried and nervous about something that may happen

example.en: She felt anxious before the job interview.
example.zh: 她在求职面试前感到很焦虑。

senses.en: strongly wanting something to happen

example.en: He was anxious to start his new job.
example.zh: 他急切地想开始新工作。

senses.en: a tendency to favor or dislike something unfairly, which prevents fair judgment

example.en: The report showed a clear bias against small companies.
example.zh: 这份报告显示出对小公司的明显偏见。

senses.en: to influence someone or something unfairly

example.en: Bad questions can bias the results of a survey.
example.zh: 不当的问题会使调查结果产生偏差。

senses.en: a diagonal direction across a fabric, not parallel to its threads

example.en: Cut the cloth on the bias so it drapes well.
example.zh: 沿斜纹方向裁剪布料，这样垂感更好。

senses.en: The middle point or area of something.

example.en: There is a fountain in the centre of the square.
example.zh: 广场中央有一个喷泉。

senses.en: A building or place used for a particular activity.

example.en: She works at a community health centre.
example.zh: 她在一家社区健康中心工作。

senses.en: To focus on something or make something focus on it.

example.en: The debate centred on the new transport plan.
example.zh: 辩论以新的交通计划为中心。

senses.en: A set of similar things gathered together or kept as a hobby.
senses.zh: 收藏品；收集在一起的一批物品

example.en: Her collection of old maps fills two shelves.
example.zh: 她的旧地图收藏占了两层架子。

senses.en: The act of gathering things together, especially over time.

example.en: The collection of data took several months.
example.zh: 数据收集花了几个月。

senses.en: Money gathered from people, especially for charity or as a payment.

example.en: The school held a collection for the animal shelter.
example.zh: 学校为动物收容所举行了募捐。

senses.en: without other people; not with anyone

example.en: She lives alone in a small apartment.
example.zh: 她独自住在一间小公寓里。

senses.en: without help or company from anyone else

example.en: He finished the work alone.
example.zh: 他独自完成了这项工作。

senses.en: used to emphasize that only one thing is involved

example.en: The name alone suggests a serious problem.
example.zh: 单是这个名字就暗示着一个严重问题。

senses.en: to take something to the place or person it is meant for

example.en: The shop delivers groceries to your door.
example.zh: 这家商店把食品杂货送到你家门口。

senses.en: to give a speech or talk to an audience

example.en: She will deliver a speech at the ceremony.
example.zh: 她将在仪式上发表演讲。

senses.en: to do what you promised or produce the expected result
senses.zh: 兑现；实现；产生（预期结果）

example.en: The new system delivers better results.
example.zh: 新系统带来了更好的结果。

senses.en: to take part in an activity or become involved in something

example.en: She engaged in a lively discussion with her colleagues.
example.zh: 她与同事们进行了热烈的讨论。

senses.en: to attract and hold someone's attention or interest

example.en: The speaker's story engaged the audience from start to finish.
example.zh: 演讲者的故事自始至终吸引着听众。

senses.en: to employ or hire someone for a job or service

example.en: The company engaged a consultant to review its safety procedures.
example.zh: 公司聘请了一名顾问来审查其安全程序。

senses.en: Relating to Jews, their culture, or their religion.
senses.zh: 犹太人的；与犹太文化或宗教有关的。

example.en: She studies Jewish history at the university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习犹太历史。

senses.en: a person who has committed a crime

example.en: The police arrested the criminal near the station.
example.zh: 警察在车站附近逮捕了那名罪犯。

senses.en: relating to crime or to the law about crime

example.en: She works in criminal law.
example.zh: 她从事刑法工作。

senses.en: the act of finding or learning something for the first time

example.en: The discovery of the new planet excited astronomers.
example.zh: 新行星的发现让天文学家们兴奋不已。

senses.en: something that is found or learned for the first time

example.en: The museum displayed a recent discovery from the shipwreck.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了从沉船中最近发现的一件物品。

senses.en: the ability of two things to work or exist together without problems

example.en: Check the software's compatibility with your operating system before installing it.
example.zh: 安装前请检查该软件与你的操作系统的兼容性。

senses.en: the quality of getting along well with another person
senses.zh: 合得来；和谐相容（的人际关系）

example.en: They got married because of their strong compatibility.
example.zh: 他们因彼此非常合得来而结了婚。

senses.en: sticking out beyond a surface or edge

example.en: A projecting ledge blocked the narrow path.
example.zh: 一块突出的岩壁挡住了狭窄的小路。

senses.en: present participle of project: to stick out, or to plan or show something
senses.zh: 突出；投射；规划（project 的现在分词）

example.en: The balcony is projecting over the street.
example.zh: 阳台悬伸在街道上方。

collocations: projecting an image onto the screen

senses.en: relating to official rules or controlling something according to rules

example.en: The company must follow all regulatory requirements before launching the product.
example.zh: 公司在推出产品前必须遵守所有监管要求。

senses.en: a person or company that buys and sells stocks, insurance, etc. for others in exchange for a commission

example.en: She called her broker to sell the shares.
example.zh: 她打电话给她的经纪人卖出股票。

senses.en: to arrange a deal or agreement between people or groups

example.en: The UN helped broker a peace deal between the two countries.
example.zh: 联合国帮助促成两国之间的和平协议。

senses.en: the Republican Party, one of the two major political parties in the United States
senses.zh: 大老党（美国共和党的别称）

example.en: The GOP will hold its convention next month.
example.zh: 共和党将于下个月召开大会。

senses.en: to say sorry for something you have done wrong

example.en: He apologised for being late to the meeting.
example.zh: 他为开会迟到而道歉。

senses.en: in disagreement or opposition with each other

example.en: The two witnesses gave conflicting accounts of the accident.
example.zh: 两位目击者对事故的说法相互矛盾。

senses.en: the branch of physics dealing with the motion of objects and the forces acting on them

example.en: Newton founded classical mechanics in the seventeenth century.
example.zh: 牛顿在十七世纪创立了经典力学。

senses.en: the practical details or technical aspects of how something is done
senses.zh: 技术细节；方法，操作规程

example.en: She learned the mechanics of writing a good essay.
example.zh: 她学会了写好文章的具体方法。

senses.en: a small number of; not many

example.en: Few students passed the exam.
example.zh: 很少有学生通过这次考试。

senses.en: a small number of people or things

example.en: Only a few were invited to the party.
example.zh: 只有少数人被邀请参加聚会。

senses.en: an expression on the face with the corners of the mouth turned up, showing pleasure

example.en: She greeted us with a warm smile.
example.zh: 她带着温暖的微笑迎接我们。

collocations: wipe the smile off someone's face

senses.en: to make a smile with your face, often to show pleasure

example.en: The baby smiled at everyone in the room.
example.zh: 婴儿对房间里的每个人都微笑。

senses.en: complete and without any faults or defects; as good as possible

example.en: The weather was perfect for a picnic.
example.zh: 这天气适合野餐，好极了。

senses.en: to make something as good as possible

example.en: She spent years perfecting her technique.
example.zh: 她花了多年时间完善自己的技术。

senses.en: (grammar) a verb tense describing an action that has been completed

example.en: Use the present perfect to talk about past actions with present results.
example.zh: 用现在完成时谈论与现在结果相关的过去动作。

senses.en: made with whole-wheat (graham) flour; whole-wheat

example.en: She offered me a graham cracker with my coffee.
example.zh: 她递给我一块全麦饼干配咖啡。

senses.en: a man that someone is having a romantic relationship with

example.en: Her boyfriend picked her up from work yesterday.
example.zh: 她男朋友昨天开车接她下班。

senses.en: to walk with regular, firm steps, especially in a group or procession

example.en: The soldiers marched across the square.
example.zh: 士兵们齐步走过广场。

senses.en: the act of walking with regular, rhythmic steps, especially by soldiers or in a procession

example.en: They went on a long march through the mountains.
example.zh: 他们进行了一次穿越群山的长途行军。

senses.en: a piece of music with a strong regular rhythm, written for marching

example.en: The band played a lively march.
example.zh: 乐队演奏了一首欢快的进行曲。

senses.en: (March, capitalized) the third month of the year

example.en: Her birthday is in March.
example.zh: 她的生日在三月。

senses.en: to annoy or irritate someone

example.en: It irks her when people interrupt her.
example.zh: 别人打断她说话时她会很恼火。

senses.en: thin and flexible, moving gracefully and easily
senses.zh: 柔韧的；体态轻盈灵活的

example.en: The lithe dancer moved across the stage effortlessly.
example.zh: 体态轻盈的舞者轻松地掠过舞台。

senses.en: never wrong or failing; completely reliable
senses.zh: 绝无差错的，一贯正确的，绝对可靠的

example.en: No method of prediction is infallible.
example.zh: 没有任何预测方法是绝对可靠的。

senses.en: to overturn in the water, said of a boat

example.en: The boat capsized in the storm.
example.zh: 船在暴风雨中倾覆了。

senses.en: a large passenger airplane used by airlines

example.en: The airliner carried three hundred passengers.
example.zh: 这架客机载着三百名乘客。

senses.en: a person who plays the violin

example.en: The violinist performed a beautiful solo.
example.zh: 那位小提琴手演奏了一段优美动听的独奏。

senses.en: a small soft round mass or shapeless mark

example.en: A blob of paint fell on the floor.
example.zh: 一滴油漆掉在了地板上。

senses.en: to make something new or bring it into existence

example.en: The team created a simple website for the event.
example.zh: 团队为这次活动创建了一个简单的网站。

senses.en: to cause a particular situation or feeling to happen

example.en: The new road may create more traffic.
example.zh: 新修的道路可能会带来更多车流。

senses.en: a serious disagreement between people or groups

example.en: The two teams had a conflict over the schedule.
example.zh: 两个团队在日程安排上发生了冲突。

senses.en: a fight or clash between opposing groups or forces

example.en: The border conflict lasted for months.
example.zh: 边境冲突持续了数月。

senses.en: to be in opposition or disagreement with something

example.en: His account conflicts with the evidence.
example.zh: 他的说法与证据相矛盾。

senses.en: a vehicle with wings and engines that flies through the air

example.en: She took a plane to Osaka.
example.zh: 她乘飞机去了大阪。

senses.en: a flat surface or level

example.en: The two lines lie on the same plane.
example.zh: 这两条线位于同一平面上。

senses.en: to make a surface smooth with a tool

example.en: He planed the edge of the board until it was smooth.
example.zh: 他把木板边缘刨平了。

senses.en: a container, often made of woven material, wire, or plastic, used for carrying or holding things

example.en: She carried a basket of fresh vegetables from the garden.
example.zh: 她从菜园里提着一篮新鲜蔬菜。

senses.en: the net and hoop used in basketball, or a score made by putting the ball through it

example.en: He scored the winning basket in the final seconds.
example.zh: 他在最后几秒投中了制胜一球。

senses.en: famous for something bad
senses.zh: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的

example.en: The city is notorious for its heavy traffic.
example.zh: 这座城市因交通拥堵严重而臭名昭著。

senses.en: a small bitter fruit eaten or used to make oil

example.en: She added a few olives to the salad.
example.zh: 她在沙拉里加了几颗橄榄。

senses.en: a Mediterranean evergreen tree that produces olives

example.en: The hillside was covered with olive trees.
example.zh: 山坡上长满了橄榄树。

senses.en: of a dull yellow-green color

example.en: He wore an olive jacket.
example.zh: 他穿着一件橄榄色的夹克。

senses.en: a small device that makes a high sound when air is blown through it

example.en: The referee blew his whistle to stop the game.
example.zh: 裁判吹响哨子停止了比赛。

senses.en: a clear high sound, for example made by blowing through the lips

example.en: He gave a sharp whistle to attract their attention.
example.zh: 他发出尖利的口哨声来引起他们的注意。

senses.en: to make a high-pitched sound by forcing air through the lips or a whistle

example.en: He whistled a cheerful tune while walking to work.
example.zh: 他步行去上班时吹着一支欢快的曲子。

senses.en: the main stem of a plant, or a thin stem that supports a leaf, flower or fruit

example.en: She trimmed the stalks off the celery before chopping it.
example.zh: 她切芹菜前先把茎去掉。

senses.en: to follow a person or animal secretly and quietly in order to catch or attack them

example.en: A cat was stalking a bird in the garden.
example.zh: 一只猫在花园里悄悄跟踪一只鸟。

senses.en: to walk in a stiff, angry or proud way
senses.zh: 高视阔步；怒气冲冲地走

example.en: He turned and stalked out of the room.
example.zh: 他转过身，大步冲出了房间。

senses.en: to be very good at something; do better than others

example.en: She excels at solving difficult math problems.
example.zh: 她擅长解决很难的数学题。

senses.en: full of energy and activity
senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的

example.en: She gave an energetic performance.
example.zh: 她的表演充满活力。

senses.en: an open area of land in a forest with few or no trees

example.en: We set up our tent in a clearing in the woods.
example.zh: 我们在林中的一块空地上搭起了帐篷。

senses.en: the process of settling financial transactions or payments between banks

example.en: The bank handles the clearing of cheques every morning.
example.zh: 这家银行每天上午处理支票清算。

senses.en: the act of removing things or making a place tidy

example.en: The clearing of snow from the roads took several hours.
example.zh: 清理道路上的积雪花了几个小时。

senses.en: a chemical element (Si) used in computer chips and electronics
senses.zh: 硅（元素符号Si，用于芯片和半导体）

example.en: Computer chips are made from silicon.
example.zh: 计算机芯片由硅制成。

senses.en: a light silvery metal used to make cans, foil and aircraft parts

example.en: The cans are made of recycled aluminum.
example.zh: 这些罐子是用回收铝制成的。

senses.en: a sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement underground

example.en: The earthquake shook the buildings for nearly a minute.
example.zh: 地震使建筑物摇晃了近一分钟。

senses.en: a tiny single-celled organism, some of which cause disease

example.en: A bacterium is too small to see without a microscope.
example.zh: 细菌小到不用显微镜就无法看见。

senses.en: used to introduce more specific information; that is to say

example.en: Two students were absent, namely Tom and Jerry.
example.zh: 有两名学生缺席，即汤姆和杰瑞。

senses.en: to make something more attractive by adding decoration

example.en: They adorned the cake with fresh flowers.
example.zh: 他们用鲜花装饰蛋糕。

senses.en: a drink made from apples: usually alcoholic in the UK, but often unfiltered apple juice in the US
senses.zh: 苹果酒（通常为英式用法）；未经滤清的苹果汁（常为美式用法）

example.en: At the American farm, we drank hot apple cider.
example.zh: 在那家美国农场，我们喝了热苹果汁。

senses.en: to officially take away someone's property, especially as a punishment

example.en: The teacher confiscated the phone during class.
example.zh: 老师在上课时没收了手机。

senses.en: a bar at the front or back of a vehicle that absorbs shock in a collision

example.en: The car's rear bumper was scratched in the parking lot.
example.zh: 汽车的后保险杠在停车场被刮花了。

senses.en: unusually large or abundant

example.en: Farmers had a bumper harvest this year.
example.zh: 今年农民获得了大丰收。

senses.en: to spoil or damage something, especially a reputation, or to contaminate something

example.en: The scandal tainted the company's reputation.
example.zh: 这起丑闻玷污了公司的声誉。

senses.en: a trace of contamination or disgrace

example.en: The taint of corruption lingered over the agency for years.
example.zh: 腐败的污点多年来一直笼罩着该机构。

senses.en: third person singular present of "be"; used to form progressive tenses
senses.zh: 是（be 的第三人称单数现在式）；构成进行时态

example.en: She is reading a book.
example.zh: 她正在读书。

senses.en: used to link a subject with a description, identity, or location

example.en: The sky is blue.
example.zh: 天空是蓝色的。

senses.en: affected by a curse; deserving a curse

example.en: Legend says the treasure lies in a cursed tomb.
example.zh: 传说宝藏藏在一座被诅咒的墓中。

senses.en: used to show annoyance (informal)

example.en: This cursed computer keeps freezing.
example.zh: 这台该死的电脑老是死机。

senses.en: to refuse to accept or recognize something as valid, such as a debt, claim, or idea
senses.zh: 拒绝承认；否认…有效；拒付

example.en: The government threatened to repudiate its foreign debts.
example.zh: 政府威胁拒绝偿付其外债。

senses.en: to reject or publicly deny a connection with a person, belief, or behavior

example.en: She repudiated the extremist views she once held.
example.zh: 她公开否认自己曾经持有的极端主义观点。

senses.en: clearly and directly stated, especially in writing or law

example.en: The contract expressly forbids subletting the apartment.
example.zh: 合同明确禁止转租该公寓。

senses.en: for one specific purpose; deliberately

example.en: She flew to London expressly to attend the conference.
example.zh: 她专程飞往伦敦参加会议。

senses.en: correct or socially acceptable behavior; conformity to social conventions

example.en: She questioned the propriety of accepting such an expensive gift.
example.zh: 她质疑接受如此昂贵的礼物是否得体。

senses.en: to surround a city or building with armed forces in order to capture it

example.en: The army besieged the city for several months.
example.zh: 军队围攻这座城市达数月之久。

senses.en: to crowd around someone or trouble them with many requests or questions

example.en: Reporters besieged the star with questions after the show.
example.zh: 演出结束后记者们围着这位明星不断提问。

senses.en: expressing opinions as if they were certainly true, unwilling to consider other views

example.en: His dogmatic style made the debate unpleasant.
example.zh: 他武断的辩论风格让人很不舒服。

senses.en: to sell goods directly to customers in small quantities

example.en: The store retails electronics at competitive prices.
example.zh: 这家商店以有竞争力的价格零售电子产品。

senses.en: the sale of goods directly to consumers, usually in small quantities

example.en: Retail has shifted heavily toward online shopping.
example.zh: 零售业已大规模转向网上购物。

senses.en: a hormone released in the small intestine that stimulates the pancreas to secrete water and bicarbonate

example.en: Secretin helps neutralize acid entering the small intestine.
example.zh: 促胰液素有助于中和进入小肠的胃酸。

senses.en: groups of people who work or play together

example.en: The two teams played a close match yesterday.
example.zh: 两支队伍昨天打了一场势均力敌的比赛。
